chunks: Ahmad ibn Abdullah, von Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, von Abdal ibn Malik, von Harun ibn al-Jahm, von al-Kahili, von Mu'adh, dem Verkäufer von Gewändern, der sagte:
Abu Abdillah (friede sei mit ihm) sagte: „Der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei mit ihm und seiner Familie) pflegte die Ziege seiner Familie zu melken.“
ai.seo_question: Was machte der Prophet Muhammad mit der Ziege seiner Familie?
ai.summary: In German, the translation of the provided English texts and key terms is as follows: The summary highlights the Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) personal engagement in domestic labor, specifically milking his family's goat, as recorded in al-Kafi by Imam al-Sadiq (AS). This act underscores the virtue of humility and the rejection of aristocratic detachment in Shia tradition, serving as a practical model for the Imams and the faithful to balance spiritual leadership with active participation in household duties, reinforcing the sanctity of everyday work. The SEO question asks what the Prophet Muhammad did with his family's goat. The key terms translated are: 1. to milk (a goat or cow), 2. a goat, 3. his family / his household, 4. the Messenger of Allah, 5. the seller of garments/clothes. }
